title: Progression
description: The DAG over instances. `nodes` are instance ids; each `edge` unlocks when the source instance's goal is met; `start` is the first instance. Exactly one start and at least one terminal (a node with no outgoing edge) is a narrator invariant checked in its tests, not by this schema.

goalRef.description: Refers to the goal whose completion traverses the edge: the source instance's goal.
